title: And On to the Next Act

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... *pant*...
Phew... Ready! I can go for the next one!
choice_data_list: All right. Next, push your timing ...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Got it! ...Focus on positioning.
Minimize lost ground around the bend.
Minimize lost ground...! —Haah!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: —Yaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Academy Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
She's been so intensely fired up since this
morning, it's crazy~
Does she have an important race coming up?
Like a graded stakes race or something?

text_block_list.name: Academy Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Nah, from what I heard...
she hasn't even debuted yet.

text_block_list.name: Academy Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, for real?!
That is NOT pre-debut levels of
intensity...!
She's going so hard I thought it was a final
fast breeze before a big race—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
A-Amazing...!
There really is data on every single
runner...! Looking at it step by step,
it's clear how steadily she's been pushing
forward.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Even though you're already sticking right
by my side
for my own training...
choice_data_list: Let's use this to figure out our s...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leading up to the mock race,
Dantsu Flame and I spent every single day
giving everything we had to do all we
could.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All to prove that Dantsu Flame
is a horsegirl capable of being the "main
star"—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And then,
the day of the mock race finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...So Agnes Tachyon is running upfront to
test the waters, after all.
Flawless movements from the start right to
this point... Truly impressive.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
The crowd favorite, Jungle Pocket,
is steadily creeping up from behind.
With her closing kick,
she should be entering striking distance
soon.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer and I built up everything we possibly
could
for this race...!
I'll definitely win and prove it...!!)

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon made the first move!
She's looking to break away from the
pack...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (Earlier than I thought! But not yet!!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ————YAAAAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(I want to win...! I want to win, I wanna win,
I wanna WIN!!
I definitely,
definitely want to win!! Right here!
Right now!!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (————I want to be... the main star!!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAHHHHHHH——————...——)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Haaah, haaah, haaah... hngh...
Ugh... hic...——

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer...——

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Dantsu Flame finished in 3rd place.
I couldn't deliver the victory I had promised
her... And so—
choice_data_list: Our contract ends here. Thank you ...
Our contract ends here. Thank you ...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
............Um, Trainer.
Could you give me...
just a little more of your time at the
end?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
............This really is delicious,
isn't it?
Even when I can't decide what to buy,
I always end up getting this in the end.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
...We're the same, then.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
If you hadn't been there for today's race,
I'm sure...
I would've lost completely...
and ended up totally crushed.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
You gave me courage.
...Courage that I can still keep aiming...
to be the "main star."
choice_data_list: ...Well, if I was able to help you...
...Well, if I was able to help you...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Even if we walk separate paths from here
on out, I won't have any regrets.
I truly feel that from the bottom of my
heart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Dantsu Flame steps up onto the stage
and looks straight into my eyes—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...I've thought this ever since I was little.
If things stay like this,
won't I just remain some vague "supporting
character" nobody remembers?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
But whenever I managed to win a race...
in that moment alone...
I truly felt like I was the "main star"
who'd live on in everyone's memories...——

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I entered this academy,
all this time, all this time...
I've kept hoping... that 'next time,
I'll stand in the center'...
And yet...――

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
Why did you... sign a contract with me...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...From all our days leading up to now,
I know.
I know that Dantsu Flame has never once
given up, and has kept working tirelessly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That she has always delivered the absolute
best results she could with her current
strength,
moving forward steadily, step by step.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That is by no means something just anyone
could do.
It's an effort to reach the "lead role" that
only Dantsu Flame could achieve.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now, I can say it clearly.
The brilliance I found within Dantsu
Flame.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...For the first time,
I stand on the very same stage.
Looking at her from the same perspective,
I put it into words.
choice_data_list: I wanted to support you because yo...
I wanted to support you as you kep...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...!
As I kept striving... me...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
......Trainer.
Our contract... is already dissolved,
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Then... this time...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Please let me scout you as my Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...It made me so happy. Truly.
You saw me when
I wasn't the star yet...
while I was still striving to become one.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
And... I realized that with you,
I could...
I could chase my dream head-on... So—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Won't you please aim to be the "main star"
together with me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her outstretched hand, her gentle smile,
and the flame burning within.
All of it seemed more dazzling than anything
in that moment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I take her hand and make a vow:
I will make her the star,
and become a Trainer worthy of standing in
the spotlight right beside her—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The opening bell chimes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And from here... the next act begins—
